analysis.summary: This is a concentrated household bleach with 6.0% sodium hypochlorite. The label marks it DANGER and corrosive to eyes and skin. Nothing on the label matches your allergies, warfarin, or vegan diet, but it is not for eating or drinking.

labelWarnings.text: Corrosive. Causes lasting eye damage and skin burns. Harmful if swallowed.
labelWarnings.evidence: CORROSIVE. Causes irreversible eye damage and skin burns. Harmful if swallowed.

labelWarnings.text: Never mix with ammonia, vinegar, toilet bowl cleaners, rust removers or other acids. Mixing makes hazardous gases.
labelWarnings.evidence: Do not mix with ammonia, vinegar, toilet bowl cleaners, rust removers or other acids. Mixing releases hazardous gases.

labelWarnings.text: Wear eye protection and rubber gloves. Use only with good ventilation.
labelWarnings.evidence: Wear protective eyewear and rubber gloves when handling.

labelWarnings.text: Keep out of reach of children. Store cool and dry, away from sun and heat.
labelWarnings.evidence: KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN.

keyFacts.label: Key hazard
keyFacts.value: DANGER: corrosive; do not mix with acids or ammonia

keyFacts.label: If in eyes
keyFacts.value: Rinse slowly with water for 15–20 minutes

keyFacts.label: If swallowed
keyFacts.value: Call a poison control center or doctor immediately

analysis.disclaimer: If this product is swallowed or gets in the eyes, call local emergency services or poison control right away and keep the label with you.
